maximize.title: Maximize your time
maximize.p1: With Relier's luxury transfers, the ease of travel is more comfortable than ever. You'll save time by skipping the airports and train stations, and can instead use the travel time how you'd like: private phone calls, last-minute presentation prep, or even catching up on sleep. Our bi-lingual chauffeurs are bound by discretion and give you the space and privacy you need to deliver your best.

stressFree.title: Stress-free solution
stressFree.p1: Booking our transfer rides as an alternative to trains, or car rentals means avoiding the crowds and staying safe on your journey. Instead of enduring long lines and multiple interactions before you even hit the road, you just enjoy the comfort of a private transfer in a top-of-the-line vehicle.

costCertainty.title: Cost certainty and flexibility
costCertainty.p1: Rates are guaranteed in advance, and our fixed pricing between your pickup and dropoff means no hidden costs. Plans change? Change or cancel your ride for free up until 24 hours before pickup. Anticipate a stop or two along the way? Relier has you covered. For small groups, our Business Van or SUV service class means additional workspace without sacrificing comfort or style.

Arriving late to a business event is a big no-no: not only does it leave a poor impression, but it can also mean missing key moments of the occasion. Avoid these setbacks with our corporate transportation services, backed by our dedicated 24/7 Dispatch Team, ensuring seamless coordination and real-time trip monitoring for a stress-free experience.

workRelax.p1: Let the chauffeur handle the driving while you sit back and focus on what matters, whether it's catching up on work, reviewing important documents, or simply unwinding. With onboard WiFi in all our vehicles, you stay connected and productive while enjoying a smooth, stress-free ride.

hero.subtitle: From conferences and corporate retreats to productions and major sports fixtures, we move groups on schedule: one coordinator, schedules and passenger manifests prepared in advance, and 24/7 dispatch for every movement.

productions.title: Artists, Crews & Productions
productions.p1: From galas and conventions to film and music productions, we coordinate fleets at scale without losing the boutique touch. Dedicated on-site leads, sedans through 56-passenger motor coaches, and the planning support to keep complex schedules on time.
productions.p2: One quote, one coordinator and one invoice for the whole run, with 24/7 dispatch monitoring every movement between venues, hotels and airports.

entertainment.title: Entertainment Events
entertainment.p1: Whatever the event you want to attend, Relier offers affordable prices on luxury car service for events in every city we operate. We have packages for all special occasions including anniversary, bachelor/bachelorette parties, birthdays, concerts, prom night, sightseeing, sports event, shopping, or any family event. Relier has the perfect transport solution for all your needs. Charter our services for your night out, or take a class on an educational field trip. We make sure to give you service that leaves you feeling safe and comfortable, and stylish at the same time.

corporate.title: Corporate Events
corporate.p1: Ensure seamless transportation for your corporate events with our private chauffeured service. Whether it's executive meetings, conferences, or corporate retreats, we provide punctual, professional, and luxurious transfers tailored to your needs. With a diverse fleet and 24/7 dispatch support, we guarantee a smooth and stress-free experience for you and your team. Arrive in style, ready for success.

sports.title: Sports Events
sports.p1: Whether it's transporting a visiting team before the big game or a top prospect to meet with a franchise executive, we've got your transportation needs covered. As the go-to charter service for major sporting events, we're trusted by athletes, agents, production crews, and professional sports franchises. Plus, we secure VIP packages for exclusive events and handle group transportation for large-scale gatherings, like the Copa América.

conferences.title: Conferences
conferences.p1: Transport all your attendees in style or make a grand entry with our specialized logistics for organizational events and conferences. Whether you want an entire sales team transported to a location or you have to arrive with a limo, we have got you covered.

items.q: Which New York airports does Relier serve?
items.a: Relier's airport car service covers JFK, LaGuardia (LGA) and Newark (EWR), plus Westchester County (HPN), Teterboro (TEB) for private aviation, Long Island MacArthur (ISP) and New York Stewart (SWF), all with a chauffeur and a fixed price shown before you book.

items.q: How much wait time is included in an airport pickup?
items.a: Every Relier airport pickup in New York includes 60 minutes of wait time on international arrivals, 40 minutes on domestic arrivals and 30 minutes at private aviation terminals. Pickups at a home, hotel or office include 15 minutes.

items.q: What happens if my flight is delayed or lands early?
items.a: Add your flight number when you book so dispatch has your arrival details. Wait time is included on every arrival, 60 minutes international and 40 domestic, and the 24/7 dispatch team is reachable at +1 (844) 735-4371 if your plans change.

items.q: Where will my chauffeur meet me at the airport?
items.a: Curbside, by default, once you have your luggage. If you prefer to be met inside the terminal, a meet and greet at baggage claim is available on request when you book.

items.q: Is the price fixed before I book?
items.a: Yes. Enter your ride details, see the fixed price, and book; no need to call or email for a quote. Every booking guarantees a class of vehicle.

items.q: Can I cancel an airport transfer free of charge?
items.a: Yes, within the notice window for your vehicle: 4 or more hours for the executive sedan and the SUV, 24 or more hours for the executive van and the Mercedes-Benz S-Class, one week or more for buses. Deposits are non-refundable.

items.q: Do you cover the Hamptons, Westchester, New Jersey and Connecticut?
items.a: Yes. Relier runs airport transfers door to door, in both directions, between JFK, LaGuardia or Newark and Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, Long Island and the Hamptons, Westchester, New Jersey and Connecticut.

items.q: Do you offer airport transfers outside New York?
items.a: Yes. Relier is headquartered in New York and Barcelona and reaches more than 500 cities worldwide through its own New York operation and selected partners elsewhere. Airport transfers in Barcelona and across Europe are booked through Relier Europe at relier.es.

closer.title: Book the car before you board.
closer.body: JFK, LaGuardia, Newark or any airport we serve: enter your ride details, see the fixed price, and book. For anything else, dispatch answers 24/7 at +1 (844) 735-4371.

alwaysOn.title: Reachable around the clock
alwaysOn.p1: Travel does not keep office hours. Our concierge line answers 24/7, so a 3am arrival or a change of plan mid-trip reaches a person who already has your booking in front of them.
alwaysOn.imageAlt: Traveler confirming a booking on a phone

closer.title: Tell us what the day looks like.
closer.body: Send the itinerary, however rough, and we come back with vehicles, timings and a fixed price — no hidden costs.

hero.title: Chauffeured Transportation for Business
hero.subtitle: Chauffeured ground transportation worldwide. For travel advisors, corporate accounts, and the teams behind every event.

advisors.title: Travel Advisors & Agencies
advisors.blurb: Book on behalf of your clients with one point of contact and 24/7 dispatch.
advisors.body: As a Virtuoso Preferred Partner, Relier is built to make advisors look good: a single point of contact, consistent service in more than 500 cities, and the discretion your clientele expects.
advisors.imageAlt: Relier chauffeured transfer for travel advisors

accounts.title: Corporate Accounts
accounts.blurb: One account, one standard, every city your team operates in.
accounts.body: Centralized billing, duty-of-care reporting and chauffeurs trained for business travel, across roadshows, client visits, conferences and daily executive travel.

events.title: Events & Productions
events.blurb: Fleets at scale for artists, crews and production teams.
events.body: From galas and conventions to film and music productions, dedicated on-site leads and vehicles from sedans to 56-passenger motor coaches keep complex schedules on time.

affiliates.title: Affiliates
affiliates.blurb: Extend one chauffeured standard through a selected partner network.
affiliates.body: Chauffeured transportation companies that meet our standard can join the network that fulfils Relier trips beyond our own operation, in New York and worldwide.

closer.title: Let's build your account.
closer.body: Tell us how your business moves and we'll tailor a program around it, with one point of contact and the same standard in every city.
closer.agentNote: Travel advisor? Ask for an agent account with commissionable rates and partner benefits.

intro.body: Relier has run chauffeured ground transportation from New York since 2012, with a second base in Barcelona and the same standard in 500+ cities. Whether you book on behalf of clients, move an executive team, run a production or operate a fleet of your own, you work with one point of contact, a 24/7 dispatch team that tracks every trip in real time, and fixed pricing confirmed in advance.

meta.title: Ground Transportation for Travel Advisors & Agencies | Relier
meta.description: Worldwide chauffeured transportation for travel advisors, agencies and hospitality teams, with one point of contact, proactive updates and 24/7 dispatch.

hero.title: Trusted by the people behind luxury travel.
hero.subtitle: Chauffeured ground transportation for travel advisors, agencies and hospitality teams, in New York, Barcelona and 500+ cities worldwide.

whatYouGet.title: What you get
whatYouGet.p1: One point of contact for every booking, from a single airport transfer to a multi-day itinerary. Real-time trip monitoring, proactive updates before your client has to ask, and a 24/7 dispatch team that treats your clients as our own.
whatYouGet.p2: Fixed pricing confirmed in advance, free changes up to 24 hours before pickup, and bilingual chauffeurs briefed on the route, the stops and the preferences.
whatYouGet.imageAlt: Relier chauffeur greeting a traveler at the vehicle

whereWeOperate.title: Where we operate
whereWeOperate.p1: Headquartered in New York and Barcelona, with the same chauffeured standard across 500+ cities in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Africa and Asia.
whereWeOperate.p2: Trips outside our own operation are fulfilled through a carefully selected partner network, held to the same service standard and coordinated by the same team.
whereWeOperate.imageAlt: Relier vehicle on a city street

ecosystem.title: Part of the luxury travel ecosystem
ecosystem.p1: Relier is a Virtuoso Preferred Partner and a member of the National Limousine Association and the NYC Association of Hotel Concierges. Our chauffeurs hold PAX professional chauffeur certification.
ecosystem.p2: That means advisors, hotels and guest-services teams book with a supplier that already speaks their language.
ecosystem.imageAlt: Relier chauffeur opening the rear door for a client

hotels.title: Hotels & guest services
hotels.p1: Hotel front desks and guest-services teams use Relier for airport arrivals, hourly service and same-day requests, with one line to call and a booking already in front of the person who answers.
hotels.imageAlt: Hotel entrance with a Relier vehicle waiting

closer.title: Talk to sales.
closer.body: Tell us how your agency books and we'll set up a program around it, with one point of contact and the same standard in every city.

events.label: Where to meet us
events.note: The Relier team attends the luxury travel and events industry’s key trade shows: ILTM, M&I Forums, IMEX, Virtuoso On Tour and Virtuoso Travel Week.

commissions.q: Do you offer commissions to travel agents?
commissions.a: Yes, Relier offers commissionable rates for travel agents and travel agencies, with special commission rates available for Virtuoso members. We regularly work with travel industry professionals, providing booking updates to both agents and passengers to ensure clear communication throughout the service. We can also offer net rates for agencies that prefer to apply their own markup.

account.q: Can my agency have its own online account?
account.a: Yes. We set up a personalized account for your agency on our online booking portal, so you can book and follow your clients’ trips in one place. Ask our team to open yours.

updates.q: Will I be kept updated on my clients’ trips?
updates.a: Yes. One point of contact handles every booking, and both you and your passengers receive booking updates. Our 24/7 dispatch team monitors every trip in real time.

where.q: Can you cover trips outside New York?
where.a: Yes. Relier operates from New York and Barcelona and delivers the same chauffeured standard in 500+ cities across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Africa and Asia, coordinated by the same team.

meta.title: Chauffeured Transportation Affiliate Network | Relier
meta.description: Partner with Relier to extend consistent chauffeured transportation service through a carefully selected global affiliate network across 500+ cities.

hero.title: Global reach. Local expertise. One standard.
hero.subtitle: Relier fulfils trips in 500+ cities through its own operation and a selected network of chauffeured transportation partners. If you run one, this is how to work with us.

ownOperation.title: Our own operation
ownOperation.p1: Relier has operated chauffeured ground transportation from New York since 2012, with a second base in Barcelona and a 24/7 dispatch team that monitors every trip in real time.
ownOperation.p2: Our clients are travel advisors, corporate accounts, productions and private travelers who expect the same experience in every city. Affiliates are how we keep that promise beyond our own fleet.
ownOperation.imageAlt: Relier chauffeur beside a black SUV in New York

partnershipModel.title: How the partnership works
partnershipModel.p1: We send you confirmed trips with the passenger details, timings and service notes already in place. You operate them to the Relier standard: professional chauffeurs, vehicles in immaculate condition, on-time pickups and a clear line to our dispatch.
partnershipModel.p2: Reciprocity is possible: partners who send work to New York or Barcelona get the same standard back from our own operation.
partnershipModel.imageAlt: Chauffeur checking a pickup on a phone

compliance.title: What we look for
compliance.p1: A chauffeured operation with professional, trained chauffeurs, a well-maintained fleet, the licensing and insurance your market requires, and the ability to confirm and track trips in real time.
compliance.p2: Our own chauffeurs hold PAX professional chauffeur certification and we are members of the National Limousine Association; we look for partners who take standards as seriously.
compliance.imageAlt: Detail of a chauffeur's hands on the wheel

closer.title: Apply to partner.
closer.body: Tell us where you operate, the size of your fleet and how you dispatch. We'll come back to you with the next steps.
